 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE PRABHAT KUMAR SINGH
ORAL ORDER 2 19-05-2023 Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and the State.

Petitioner apprehends arrest in a case registered for the offence punishable under sections 379, 420,
120 (B), 427/34 of the Indian Penal Code.
It is alleged that all the FIR named accused persons including this petitioner were involved in illegal excavation, stocking and transportation of the sand.

It is submitted that petitioner has falsely been implicated in this case only on the basis of suspicion and no incriminating material has been recovered from the conscious possession of the petitioner.
It is further submitted that petitioner is farmer and he has no concern with the alleged stock of sand.
The alleged sand in question was already seized so no loss at all Patna High Court CR.

MISC. No.
16802 of 2023(2) dt.19-05-2023 has been caused to the government.
Hence, no case is made out against the petitioner in the alleged section of the IPC.
Learned counsel for the State opposes the bail petition of the petitioner.
